body:
Steps 11–13 of the refactor plan (task:fc9bf315f4eddc7a, notes 6 and 12). This is part 4 of 4 of the module splits.

- **`lockdown`:** split into `settings`, `paths`, `files`, `commands` and `recovery`. Keep `dispatch` as the facade, and keep dispatch and validation behavior unchanged.
- **`tasks`:** split into `server`, `store`, `strategy` and `api`. Keep the inbox order and the guarantee that only one writer changes the task store at a time.
- **`board`:** split into `task_model`, `runs`, `reviews`, `briefs` and `server`. Keep `agents`, `setup` and `strategy` as they are, and leave `board` as a thin facade.

`lockdown` and `tasks` still have inline `mod tests`, so move code out of them first.

The rules for every split task are in task:2414798176c466e4.
title: Refactor: split lockdown, tasks, board
